column1: # The target catalog of v1.1: every surface the Avalonia interface will have (harness design 2.3).
# Read from tables 5a to 5e of docs/design/Surface-Inventory-and-Target-Map.md (the target map), with the Settings page
# laid out as #375 has it (four tabs, not 5a's seven panels). Read by Parity/ParityMap.cs; checked by Parity/ParityMapTests.cs.
# One row per destination named in 5a, 5b and 5d, and one per Stage panel host in 5c. A 5c merge into a page or page
# part that already has a row reuses that row. Message boxes (the map's section 6) are not surfaces here. 66 rows.
#   key        Window/..., Page/... (a page, or a section or panel of it), Part/... (one part shown on several pages),
#   map rows   the inventory rows (the map's section 3, 1 to 97) the surface takes over, separated by commas
#   built by   the GitHub issue of the plan's build that builds it (Avalonia-Migration-Plan.md section 8): build N is
#   state      planned, or built once TargetSurfaceCatalog in this project has its factory (and only then)
#   read from  where in the target map (or #375) the row was read
#   note       may be left out; required when no view in parity-map.tsv goes to the surface: why none does
